description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and the majority voting accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Number of iterations" and is on a linear scale ranging from 2^0 to 2^8. The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" and is on a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6. There are three lines in the plot, each with a different color, marker shape, and line style. The blue line with circle markers and a solid line style starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 and ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.6. The green line with triangle markers and a dashed line style starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.3 and ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.5. The light blue line with diamond markers and a dotted line style starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.3 and ends at an accuracy of approximately 0.4.
